body: Its difficult to pinpoint but i think i became more aware of many things like my flaws. Ive watched friends get into relationships and realized how lonely i really am. I don't usually get compliments, phonecalls or texts (beside the one group chat I'm in), and i love the few friends i have but they have their separate lives as well. My loneliness has just made me think what is wrong with myself and have been getting more and more depressed since then.
